players.product: Silicon nitride (Si3N4) ceramic substrates for power modules

quarterly_data.signal: H1 FY2026 (April - September 2025): net sales JPY 196,699 million, down JPY 2,354 million (1.2%), as higher volumes of electronics and advanced products were offset by price revisions following lower raw-material and fuel prices and the stronger yen; operating income JPY 9,740 million (up 3.8%), ordinary income JPY 6,791 million (up 21.8%) and net income attributable to owners of the parent JPY 3,902 million (up 15.7%). Elastomers & Infrastructure Solutions posted an operating loss of JPY 3,413 million (prior-year H1: operating loss JPY 3,033 million). H1 R&D expenses JPY 7,516 million.

quarterly_data.signal: Electronics & Innovative Products segment, H1 FY2026: net sales JPY 50,118 million (up JPY 5,061 million, 11.2%) and operating income JPY 6,306 million (up 28.0%). Spherical silica sales rose on expanding demand for generative AI and spherical alumina was firm; acetylene black rose overall as high-voltage cable sales exceeded the prior year while xEV sales fell; ALSINK heat-dissipation plates rose on recovering railway demand and growing HVDC demand.
